newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit down, but in range despite deficit talk.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit down, but in range despite deficit talk.

text.p: The ringgit was slightly lower but in a range at close of the Kuala Lumpur market despite talk of a large Malaysian trade deficit in July, dealers said.
They said profit-taking against the Singapore dollar and some short-covering against the U.S. dollar kept the ringgit under pressure for most part of the day.
One Singapore-based currency dealer said renewed interest in the country over the past few days had left the market slightly short dollar, which was covered today.
"The ringgit was well bidded today," he said.

Dealers said the profit-taking in ringgit/Sing followed a round of heavy inflows into Malaysia in the last two days. "There is some profit-taking in ringgit/Sing after it faced strong resistance at the 0.5660 (per ringgit) level," a dealer with a Singapore-based European bank said.
However, funds continue to flow from Sing to ringgit through swaps, some dealers said. "The swaps premium is still in favour of ringgit," a dealer with another Singapore-based bank said.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4980/85 per dollar against 2.4960/67 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5642/52 against 0.5655/60.
